svg.data-weight: 15.7 lb (7.1 kg) with the 600 W AC supply (datasheet); 15-17 lb (6.8-7.7 kg) with one supply (guide Table 5)
svg.data-weight-chassis-parts: 320 W AC and 190 W DC supplies 2.5 lb (1.1 kg); 600 W and 930 W AC supplies 3.1 lb (1.4 kg) (guide Table 5)
svg.data-depth-no-psu: 431.8 mm (17 in, 43.18 cm) with no supply, with the 320 W AC or with the 190 W DC supply (guide Table 5)
svg.data-datasheet-dimensions: 17.41 x 1.72 x 16.43 in (44.21 x 4.32 x 41.73 cm) W x H x D, and 18.8 in (47.8 cm) deep with a 600 W or 930 W supply; the guide's Table 5 is used for the envelope
svg.data-width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in, 48.2 cm) with the mounting brackets attached
svg.data-psu-redundancy: none; the guide says the supply "is not redundant"
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 55.6 dBA with the 600 W AC supply (datasheet, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 3048 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
svg.data-uplink-module: one slot; EX-UM-4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP or the XFP module (not part of the shipping configuration)
svg.data-poe: IEEE 802.3af on all 24 ports, 15.4 W each, up to 18.6 W with enhanced PoE
svg.data-oob: RJ-45 management port on the rear, 100 Mbps full duplex, with link/activity and status lamps
svg.data-lcd: 2 lines of 16 characters with Menu and Enter buttons
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear
svg.data-nebs: NEBS certified except the EX3200-24P and EX3200-48P (datasheet compliance section)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003, VCCI Class A

g.data-description: Rear panel - lit when the chassis temperature has risen above the permitted level and the system has shut down
g.title: led-temp

g.data-description: Tables 7 and 8 - Link/Activity green blinking with activity, steady without, off when the port is not active; Status green steady when the administrative status is enabled, off when disabled
g.title: mgmt

g.data-input-current: 7 A (guide Table 12, switches with 24 PoE ports)
g.title: psu-0--module

g.data-description: the rear earthing terminal, two 10-32 screws for a two-hole lug (Table 33)
g.title: ground-pair
